Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first search result (Step 1), the WebSurfer extracted information from a GenoPro source that incorrectly stated Prince William of Hesse-Kassel's paternal grandparents were "Prince Frederik The 2. of House Hesse-Kassel and Princess Mary of House Hanover." This is historically inaccurate for William (born 1787). William's father was Prince Frederick of Hesse-Kassel (born 1771), whose mother was Princess Louise of Denmark and Norway. The error stems from the WebSurfer relying on a genealogical database (GenoPro) that appears to have confused generations or individuals within the Hesse-Kassel family, specifically mixing up the lineage of William (1787) with a different branch or generation involving Princess Mary of Great Britain (who was the wife of Frederick II, the grandfather of William's father). The Planner later identified this conflict but the initial error was introduced by the WebSurfer's extraction in Step 1.
